info.name: Sanad App — Chat
info.description: Authenticated Chat surface (frozen contract endpoints 1-4, 5-8, 9-11): conversation list/open-or-get, message cursor list/send with idempotency, attachment upload/serve, read marks, unread totals, block/unblock/list, per-user hiding, and report submit. Requires a session-bound Normal access token (login/refresh `accessToken` carrying `sid`); legacy unbound tokens are rejected with 401/403 — refresh after login. The Support review routes (endpoints 12-15) live in the Sanad.Admin.Chat collection. Use Sanad.local.postman_environment.json and supply a disposable access token in the accessToken collection variable; set recipientUserId to a second disposable user. Requests, bodies, and response examples are statically authored from the verified controller/handler behavior and docs/chat/reports/lane-a-*.md + lane-b-*.md — they were never executed against a live API or database, and no secrets are stored here.

item.name: 01. Conversations
item.description: Endpoints 1 and 2. All routes resolve the participant from the JWT (401 without a token); unknown, foreign, and ineligible ids answer the same generic privacy 404.

request.description: Endpoint 1 → 200 PagedResult {items, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages}, ordered by lastActivityOnUtc descending. page is clamped up to 1; pageSize is clamped to 1–100 (default 20). Only the caller's conversations appear, minus rows the caller hid; foreign rows are never an error. participant is always the other side of the pair (Identity display name, English preferred with Arabic fallback; avatarUrl may be null) with the counterpart's accountType (Identity AccountType integer; a care-home owner presents as the facility name/cover). Lane A stub: lastMessage is null and unreadCount is 0 until Lane B owns messages. 401 without a token.

response.name: 200 — Page of conversations (Lane A stub fields)

request.description: Endpoint 2 → always 200, never a duplicate: created=true means new history; created=false returns the existing row for the same normalized pair + booking reference (and reopens it for this caller only if this caller had hidden it — the peer's hidden flag and lastActivityOnUtc stay untouched). Exactly one target is required: this request opens a direct chat (recipientUserId only); see 'Open or get conversation (booking)' for a booking chat. Both/neither target is 400 Chat.Conversation.OpenTargetInvalid. Self-open, unknown/deleted recipient, empty recipient id, unknown bookings, bookings the caller is not a party to, and cancelled/expired/refunded bookings all collapse into the same generic 404 Chat.Conversation.NotFound. Not yet checked (documented gap): the direct-chat role/participant matrix from docs/chat/plan.md.

response.name: 200 — New conversation (created true)
200 — Existing conversation returned (created false)
404 — Ineligible/unknown open (generic privacy 404)

request.description: Endpoint 2 (booking mode) → always 200, never a duplicate. Exactly one target: bookingId alone; the backend resolves the counterpart from the booking (it must exist, have the caller as a party, and not be cancelled/expired/refunded — a Families booking is rejected when CancelledByFamily/CancelledByCaregiver/Refunded/Expired, a care-home booking when Expired/Cancelled/Refunded). Every resource-shaped denial is the same generic 404 Chat.Conversation.NotFound; both/neither target is 400 Chat.Conversation.OpenTargetInvalid.

item.name: 02. Attachments
item.description: Endpoints 5 and 6. Conversation-scoped, uploader-bound uploads in private storage; serving is controller-authorised and participant-only.

request.description: Endpoint 5 → 201 {attachmentId, fileName, contentType, sizeBytes}; fileName is the sanitized echo of the original name (last path segment, fallback "file") while storage uses a generated safe key. multipart/form-data with a single file field is required (415 otherwise). Limits by declared type: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp ≤ 5 MB (5,242,880); video/mp4 ≤ 50 MB (52,428,800); application/pdf ≤ 10 MB (10,485,760) — documents are PDF-only in Lane A, no voice notes. Magic bytes are verified against the declared type (a matching content type alone is never trusted). Errors: 400 Chat.Attachment.Invalid (missing/empty file, length mismatch, signature mismatch, persistence failure), 400 Chat.Attachment.TooLarge, 400 Chat.Attachment.UnsupportedType; 404 generic privacy (Chat.Conversation.NotFound) when the conversation id is unknown or the caller is not a participant — that gate runs before file validation; the host also caps the whole request at 50 MB (413/connection reset). Uploads are created unbound and bind to a single message when Lane B's send path runs. Select a local file before sending.

request.description: Endpoint 6 → 200 raw bytes with the stored content type plus Cache-Control: no-store and Pragma: no-cache. The route carries the attachment id only: the participant check runs against the conversation the attachment belongs to, so the client can never steer it. Participant-only: unknown attachment id, foreign caller, and a missing blob all return the identical generic 404 (Chat.Attachment.NotFound), so the caller cannot tell which check failed. No signed URLs exist in V1; 401 without a token.

item.name: 03. Read state
item.description: Endpoint 7. Per-user read watermark recorded verbatim; unread counts and read ticks are Lane B's to interpret.

request.description: Endpoint 7 (POST) → 204, idempotent: one row per (conversation, user), so repeats update the same row and refresh its ReadOnUtc stamp. The message id is recorded verbatim — any non-empty GUID is accepted, and unread counts/read ticks are interpreted from the stored mark. Errors: 400 Chat.ConversationRead.Invalid for a participant sending the empty GUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 or an omitted lastReadMessageId property; a non-GUID or missing body never reaches the handler (generic model-binding 400, no Chat code); the generic privacy 404 for unknown/foreign conversations runs before payload validation, so a malformed body is never an existence oracle. A read mark never changes lastActivityOnUtc, hiding, or visibility, and survives hide/reopen.

item.name: 04. Blocks
item.description: Endpoint 9. Per-user, directional blocks. Block state is not consulted by any Lane A route; Lane B enforces it at send time with the generic non-participant failure.

request.description: Endpoint 9 → 204, idempotent (a repeated block of the same user succeeds again; the unique pair index is the database backstop). Directional: the (blocker, blocked) row denies sends FROM the blocked user TO the blocker at Lane B send time, while the blocker may still send. Errors: 400 Chat.Block.Invalid for self-block or an empty/absent blockedUserId; the generic privacy 404 (Chat.Block.NotFound) when the target id is not registered, so this route can never probe whether an arbitrary user id exists. Blocking changes nothing about conversations today (list, open, read, hide, upload, serve are unaffected).

item.name: 05. Hide conversation
item.description: Endpoint 10. Hide is a per-user visibility flag, not a delete — the peer keeps the history and nothing is erased.

request.description: Endpoint 10 → 204, idempotent for participants. The row disappears from this caller's GET conversations list while the other party keeps it and its full history; nothing is erased (there is no erasure path in V1, retention is indefinite). Hiding is not activity: lastActivityOnUtc, read marks, and the peer's view are untouched. Reopen by calling "Open or get conversation" again for the same pair (+ booking) — that returns created:false and unhides the caller only. Unknown or foreign conversation ids answer the generic privacy 404. 401 without a token.

item.name: 06. Messages (Lane B)
item.description: Endpoints 3 and 4. Immutable send-only messages with per-conversation idempotency keys; cursor list newest first. Send-time enforcement of blocks (generic failure) and hiding; a successful create fires an ids-only in-app alert through the notification seam (no second alert on replay).

request.description: Endpoint 3 → 200 {items, nextCursor, hasMore}, ordered by (createdOnUtc, id) descending. pageSize defaults to 30 and is clamped to 1–100 (never rejected). Omit beforeId for the newest page; pass the previous nextCursor back as beforeId to page older (a raw message id also works when it resolves inside this conversation). Write side effect: the recipient's first fetch stamps deliveredOnUtc (set-once, server UTC) on every returned message they did not send; the sender's fetch never stamps their own messages; only messages the fetch actually returns are stamped. readOnUtc on each item is computed from the reader's read mark (the reader is whoever did not send the message) — see docs/app/chat/messages.md for the full read rule. Errors: 404 generic privacy (Chat.Conversation.NotFound) for unknown, foreign, or hidden-for-requester conversations (reopen with endpoint 2 restores); 404 generic privacy (Chat.Message.NotFound) for a malformed beforeId or one that names a message unknown to or outside this conversation — the parameter can never probe ids; 401 without a token.

request.description: Endpoint 4 → 201 on create, 200 on an exact replay of the same clientMessageId with the same content (the body is the message item either way; the status code alone tells them apart), 409 Chat.Message.IdempotencyConflict when the key is reused with different content. Messages are immutable (no edit/delete) and retention is indefinite; all stamps are server-set UTC. Payload rules (each failure → 400 Chat.Message.Invalid): type must be the name Text, File, or Location (case-insensitive, never numeric); clientMessageId is trimmed, 1–100 chars, unique per conversation; Text requires trimmed text of 1–2000 chars, no attachmentId, no location; File requires attachmentId (not the empty GUID), no text, no location, and an attachment of this conversation uploaded by the sender that is not already bound (an unknown/foreign/cross-conversation attachment id is instead the generic privacy 404 Chat.Attachment.NotFound; an already-bound one is the 400); Location requires latitude (-90…90) and longitude (-180…180) with an optional label (≤200 chars), no text, no attachmentId — participant-only exactly like text. Gate order: unknown, foreign, and hidden-for-requester conversations, and a blocked sender, all answer the identical generic privacy 404 (Chat.Conversation.NotFound) — the blocked sender never learns a block exists; a non-participant with a malformed body still gets the 404, never a validation code. Sending bumps lastActivityOnUtc. Side effect: after the row commits, an awaited ids-only in-app alert is produced for the non-sender (conversation id + message id, never the text); an exact replay fires no second alert, and a producer failure surfaces to the client while the message stays committed (a retry with the same key takes the 200 replay path — documented V1 residual: that message may go unalerted).

item.name: 07. Unread count (Lane B)
item.description: Endpoint 8. Requester-scoped unread totals over visible conversations; the same read rule backs each conversation's unreadCount in the list and the readOnUtc ticks on items.

request.description: Endpoint 8 → always 200 {unreadMessagesCount, unreadConversationsCount} (a requester with nothing visible answers 0/0 — this route has no 404 path). unreadMessagesCount counts messages the caller did not send that the read rule does not count as read for them; unreadConversationsCount counts visible conversations holding at least one such message. Conversations the caller hid are excluded entirely (a hidden conversation cannot contribute a badge; reopening via endpoint 2 restores it). The read rule (docs/app/chat/messages.md): an explicit read stamp wins; otherwise the caller's read mark (endpoint 7) is a watermark over (createdOnUtc, id) when its lastReadMessageId resolves inside the conversation; a Lane A-era unresolvable id falls back to the mark's own timestamp; no mark means nothing is read. 401 without a token.

response.name: 200 — Unread totals
200 — Nothing visible (0/0)

item.name: 08. Report conversation (Lane B)
item.description: Endpoint 11. A participant reports a conversation or one message in it; Support reviews via the Sanad.Admin.Chat collection (endpoints 12-15).

request.description: Endpoint 11 → 201 {reportId}; the new report enters the Support queue as Open. Only a participant may report (a hidden conversation still qualifies — reporting is how it reaches Support). messageId is optional: null reports the conversation as a whole; a value must be a message of THIS conversation (unknown ids, the empty GUID, and another conversation's message id are the indistinguishable generic privacy 404 Chat.Report.NotFound). reason is trimmed and must be 1–500 characters (else 400 Chat.Report.Invalid). Gate-then-validate: membership and message ownership run before reason validation, so a non-participant probing with a bad reason still gets the 404 and the endpoint can never probe conversation ids. Submitting is not idempotent — two submits create two reports. Review, dismiss, and uphold live on the admin surface (Chat.SupportAdmin: SuperAdmin + SupportAdmin). 401 without a token.

item.name: 09. Sync and recovery
item.description: Chat Plus sync: GET /api/v1/chat/conversations/{{conversationId}}/sync. Same participant/visibility authorization as the message list; pageSize defaults to 100 and is clamped to 1-100. Run snapshot, then next-page, until hasMore is false; test scripts chain {{syncCursor}}. See docs/app/chat/sync.md.

request.description: Empty cursor starts the consistent snapshot: paginated immutable messages in stable total order, then changes beyond the captured revision boundary. A caught-up page still returns nextCursor for the next poll. Do not advance the stored cursor until its whole page is applied. Malformed/foreign cursor is the generic privacy 404; an authentic but expired/unsupported cursor returns an empty page with resetRequired=true and nextCursor=null (start a new snapshot). 401 without a token.

response.name: 200 — Snapshot page (message + receipt deltas)
200 — Reset required (stale cursor, empty page)
404 — Unknown, foreign, or hidden conversation (generic privacy 404)

request.description: Follow-up page: pass the previous response's nextCursor back as cursor (chained automatically from {{syncCursor}} by the snapshot test script). Re-poll until hasMore is false. revision is a decimal string; MessageCreated payloads are full message items; receipt payloads merge monotonically. 401/403 stop blind retries and reconcile authorization.

response.name: 200 — Change page (caught up)

request.description: Receipt-only change page: items of type MessageReceiptUpdated carry {conversationId, messageId, deliveredOnUtc, readOnUtc} with null meaning absent. Dedupe by message id/revision, apply in order, then merge buffered socket events and sync again. Unchanged receipts produce no new event.

item.name: 10. Privacy and presence
item.description: Chat Plus privacy: GET+PUT /api/v1/chat/privacy (owner-only, full replacement, both booleans required, defaults false) and the presence snapshot GET /api/v1/chat/conversations/{{conversationId}}/presence (null = undisclosed/unknown; blocks suppress). See docs/app/chat/realtime.md.

request.description: Owner-only read of the caller's own presence privacy settings. Both default false for new and legacy users. 401 without a token.

response.name: 200 — Privacy settings (defaults)

request.description: Owner-only full replacement: both booleans are required (omitted fields are not defaulted). A change evicts/refreshes affected subscriptions before further dispatch. Disabling withdraws previously shown state; clients re-apply the REST presence snapshot. 401 without a token.

response.name: 200 — Privacy settings replaced

request.description: Permitted counterpart presence snapshot for one conversation. isOnline null means undisclosed/unknown (not offline); lastSeenOnUtc null means withheld or unknown after restart. Either-direction block suppresses both fields without removing REST history access. Re-apply this snapshot after privacy changes, authorization changes, foreground, and reconnect. Unknown/foreign/hidden conversations answer the generic privacy 404. 401 without a token.

response.name: 200 — Presence undisclosed (nulls)

item.name: 11. Pricing insights
item.description: Chat Plus pricing: GET /api/v1/caregiver/pricing-insights?areaId=&serviceId=. Requires a CAREGIVER JWT (CaregiverAccess policy, Normal access) — the default app token will answer 403. Both ids must be nonempty GUIDs of active catalogue entries or 400 Caregivers.PricingInsights.InvalidFilter. See docs/app/chat/pricing-insights.md.

Attribution is recorded at POST /api/v1/family/bookings/checkout via optional bookingAreaId+bookingServiceId (both-together-or-neither). Use a caregiver JWT for {{accessToken}}.
